script:
# D3-EN-002: Lactase acts on the milk substrate pool, not on free glucose
# Simulation candidate; no runtime observations are claimed.
register lv3
new
new
add v1 whole_milk 40g
add v1 lactase 0.05g
add v2 whole_milk 40g
add v3 water 35mL
add v3 glucose 2g
add v3 lactase 0.05g
wait 30min
look v1
look v2
look v3
measure v1 balance
measure v2 balance
inspect
